subject: Staged adoption & close plan — MAP checkpoint and evaluation milestones
messages:
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: olivia.park@novushealth.com, michael.lee@novushealth.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0000
Subject: Staged adoption & close plan — MAP checkpoint and evaluation milestones

Hi Olivia / Michael —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our conversation, attaching a refreshed MAP (Novus_MAP_v3.pdf) that stages the rollout by team and ties evaluation milestones to the staged commit. High level:

- Week 0–2: data connection + security sign-off (Marcus lead)
- Week 3–6: pilot with Care Coordination team (Evelyn on enablement)
- Week 7–10: scale to 3 additional teams + add-on activation (Billing integration)

Immediate asks for this week:
1) Please confirm the two pilot users for Care Coordination (owner: Olivia)
2) Legal/Procurement requested a redline window — can we target a final SOW by 11/20? (owner: Michael)
3) Marcus will share the SOC2 checklist answers by EOD Thursday.

I also pulled together an evaluation playbook that maps success metrics to checkpoints (attached). Suggested success metrics for pilot: 1) 2k queries/day across pilot users, 2) <250ms 90th-pct token latency, 3) zero PII incidents in the initial 30 days.

Proposed next steps: quick sync on Thursday 11/12 to confirm pilot users and procurement timeline. If that works I’ll send an invite.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123
[Attachment: Novus_MAP_v3.pdf (application/pdf)]

Laura — thanks, this is helpful. Quick answers:

- Pilot users: Dr. Sonia Ramos and Care Coord Lead Jason Park (I’ll confirm emails by EOD Friday)
- SOW timing: Procurement can review a redline but needs at least 5 business days. If we receive the draft by 11/13 we should be able to sign by 11/23.
- Security: I’ll book a follow-up with our security lead to review Marcus’ checklist on 11/16.

Couple of notes from internal: billing team wants clarity on add-on pricing if we go beyond pilot. Can you include a short pricing appendix in the SOW?

Thanks —

Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Staged adoption & close plan — MAP checkpoint and evaluation milestones

Morning — quick checkpoint before we go into next week. Short update and confirmed owners below: 

Recap of current state:
- Security: Marcus uploaded SOC2 evidence and confirmed allowlist task will complete 11/18 (on track).
- Pilot users: Olivia to confirm emails (awaiting); onboarding session tentatively 11/22.
- SOW: Draft shared via DocuSign link; requested pricing appendix included.

Confirmed owners & next milestones:
- Olivia: confirm pilot user list and availability for 11/22 onboarding (due 11/20)
- Michael: procurement to provide any redline comments by 11/23 (due 11/23)
- Marcus: finalize network routing and send test token by 11/18 (done)
- Evelyn: deliver enablement deck + 1-hour runbook by 11/20 (in progress)
- Laura: finalize pilot success criteria doc and run the first evaluation on 12/03 (owner: laura; deliverable: Evaluation_Playbook_Novus.xlsx)

Open risks & mitigation:
1) Procurement timing — mitigation: offer a short-term pilot contract addendum to accelerate legal sign-off for pilot scope.
2) Add-on pricing clarity — mitigation: include transparent per-seat and per-embeddings tiers in appendix; Ben will own a follow-up pricing call if needed.

Please reply with any changes. If everyone is aligned I’ll convert the MAP into a milestone tracker and share weekly updates on Monday mornings.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
